hook.name: HID Domain Registry Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook on an ETH/HID token pool that collects 1% protocol fees on ETH input (buy swaps) and 1% of ETH output (sell swaps) via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta. When hookData encodes a domain name and the ETH input meets a configurable threshold, afterSwap optionally registers the domain on-chain for the swapper (tx.origin).
